5797.title: [4.155] Backport four Skia CVE fixes and the emdawnwebgpu link fix (#5316)
5797.body:
* [4.155] Backport four Skia CVE fixes and the emdawnwebgpu link fix (#5316)

Pin externals/skia to an m155 backport carrying four more upstream Skia
security fixes, and backport #5316 (and its Skia half, mono/skia#396) so
WASM apps that link C sources build again.

~~ Skia security fixes (all Chrome-assigned, Chromium severity High) ~~

- CVE-2026-118340, integer overflow leaking cross-origin data. Chromium
  bug 568936530, upstream 8700229923 "[skif] Update SkImageFilter_Base
  uniqueID to 64-bit" (M156: c68d7fd343).
- CVE-2026-119261, SkSL buffer overflow. Chromium bug 574213633, upstream
  0a8b2fc486 "[SkSL] Reject invalid types when parsing" (M156: 961c7e83d9).
- CVE-2026-121086, heap OOB write in SkRgnBuilder for conic paths.
  Chromium bug 569674218, upstream 50a301ac1c (M156: c433a0fce9).
- CVE-2026-126912, heap-buffer-overflow in RunBasedAdditiveBlitter and the
  AAA convex walker. Chromium bug 569286603, upstream reland 866b61ca92
  (M156: 0ac7dc6087).

Google backported these to m156 and later but not m155. All four
M156 cherry-picks applied to m155 without conflicts.

~~ Ship emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp inside libSkiaSharp.a (#5316) ~~

4.155 includes #3968, so its WASM targets compile Dawn's webgpu.cpp on the
app's emcc link line with -std=c++20, which clang rejects for any C source
the app links (for example Uno Platform 7's uno_gl_shim.c). Build the port
into libSkiaSharp.a through mono/skia#396's skiasharp_emdawnwebgpu_dir GN
argument instead, and stop putting the source, -std=c++20 and
DEFAULT_TO_CXX on the link line. The targets and build.cake changes are
identical to #5316; only the submodule and cgmanifest pins differ.

C API declarations, DEPS, managed APIs and package versions are unchanged,
and upstream_merge_commit still names the last incorporated chrome/m155
commit.

(cherry picked from commit 9745920251930a92b1b4a2a946f402d3eed8bef4)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* [m155] Repin Skia to the ancestry-preserving CVE repair

Context: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/465

Point externals/skia and the matching component manifest entry at
e6cfc7a5d6dea7e8c21a59782c672a00b1fff28c. The repaired native history
contains all seven original reviewed commits from mono/skia#461 and
mono/skia#462 while retaining both squash landings.

The native tree is identical to reviewed head 221ae11c5318. This
changes only the two pins, not the security or WASM implementation.
For this combined repair, verify original-commit ancestry and tree
equality explicitly rather than requiring a direct-parent relationship.

5793.title: [4.155] Backport CVE-2026-126871 and CVE-2026-126882 fixes
5793.body:
[4.155] Backport CVE-2026-126871 and CVE-2026-126882 fixes (#5793)

Context: #5687 (4.156.1 already carries both fixes)
Requires: mono/skia#461

Pin the two m155 Skia security fixes into the 4.155 servicing line for
4.155.2. The submodule and Component Governance hash point to
`168d7202034d`, the squash merge of mono/skia#461. Its tree matches the
reviewed backport head `74a1a34d40`, so repinning did not change the
reviewed code. Keep `upstream_merge_commit` at the last chrome/m155 sync:
these are m156 cherry-picks, not a new m155 upstream merge. No C API,
managed API, or package versions change.

~~ Graphite clip render-step overflow ~~

CVE-2026-126871 (Chromium bug 574218401; M156 fix `160aff2851`):
DrawListLayer recorded clip draws without accounting for pending clip
elements in the draw-pass render-step limit, allowing pipeline data
structures to overflow. Count undrawn clip elements when checking the
limit, retain deferred-clip budgeting when DrawListLayer is disabled,
and skip with a warning when a draw and its full clip stack cannot fit
even in a fresh pass. `DeviceTestClipRenderStepLimits` exercises batches
that require flushing, a pathological clip stack, and a normal draw
after the skipped draw.

~~ Ganesh skewed elliptical rounded-rectangle geometry ~~

CVE-2026-126882 (Chromium bug 578685706; M156 fix `24e65cdd9b`):
Elliptical rounded-rectangle ops used incorrect skew-matrix terms when
mapping radii and stroke widths, producing incorrect geometry under
skew or anisotropic transforms. Use the correct matrix terms and clamp
transformed corner radii to half the mapped bounds to prevent
self-intersections. The m155 cherry-pick applied without conflicts.
